description: Run the independent trust check on one of the account's agents, from public data only (the same check any third party can run): discovery records, the transparency-log entry and its inclusion proof, the log's signed checkpoint, the certificate the host serves, and DANE. Returns `verified` and `tier`: bronze (served certificate matches the registry), silver (+ DANE, needs a DNSSEC-signed zone), gold (+ transparency log). If `dnssecOffer` names a domain, enable_ans_dnssec can lift it to silver/gold.

agent_id.description: The agentId from register_ans_agent or list_ans_agents.
